source_basis: NCCP 00219 v6; EMA Tarceva sections 4.2–4.6, checked 2026-10-29.

risks.label: Diarrhoea, dehydration and kidney problems
risks.detail: Keep the prescribed anti-diarrhoea plan available from the first dose. Report loose stools early and keep drinking if able. Persistent or severe diarrhoea, weakness, inability to drink or much less urine requires urgent advice. The team decides whether to hold treatment and when it is safe to restart.

risks.label: Skin, nail and mouth problems
risks.detail: Use the agreed skin, nail and mouth-care plan. Report rash, painful nails or mouth sores early. Emollients and sun protection may help; the team decides whether creams, antibiotics or other treatment are needed. Blistering or peeling skin needs urgent assessment.

risks.label: Serious lung inflammation
risks.detail: New or worsening cough, breathlessness or fever needs urgent assessment. Treatment is held during investigation; confirmed ILD requires stopping.

risks.label: Liver injury
risks.detail: Blood tests monitor liver function. Report yellow skin or eyes, dark urine or worsening symptoms promptly.

risks.label: Eye inflammation
risks.detail: Eye pain, redness, light sensitivity or blurred vision needs prompt review.

risks.label: Rare bowel perforation
risks.detail: Severe persistent abdominal pain needs urgent assessment.

risks.label: Medicine interactions
risks.detail: Give pharmacy all medicines and supplements. Strong CYP3A4 inducers or inhibitors, grapefruit and medicines for stomach acid can change exposure. Avoid proton pump inhibitor combinations unless the specialist resolves the plan. Necessary antacids require source-specific separation; ask for written timing. Warfarin needs extra blood-clotting checks. Smoking reduces exposure; get cessation support and do not change your cancer dose yourself.

risks.label: Pregnancy, fertility and breastfeeding
risks.detail: Avoid pregnancy. Use effective contraception during treatment and for at least 2 weeks after the final dose. Do not breastfeed during treatment or for at least 2 weeks after the final dose. Discuss fertility and future pregnancy plans before starting.
